# Quaternius assets in this project

## Player character
- Pack: Animated Men, `Male_Casual.fbx` (installed at `Assets/Resources/PlayerCharacter/Models/CivilianMale.fbx`).
- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/animatedmen.html
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal; pack `License.txt` is retained in `AnimatedMen/License.txt`.

## Animation clips
- Pack: Universal Animation Library (Standard), `UAL1_Standard.fbx` (root motion disabled).
- Source: https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal (the downloaded `License.txt` and `README.txt` are retained in this folder).
- Used clips include locomotion and crouching. No suitable table-protection animation has been verified; the former project-authored IK pose was removed because it drove the hands and body to unreliable world-space targets.

Downloaded 2026-10-11 for the TurkiyeAfet Unity project. Assets may be reused under CC0 1.0 Universal.
